violated_contract: A monitoring panel must query the metric family, emitting job and label values that actually represent the named result. Pre-initialized series from unrelated jobs must not enter the result, client and server journey names are not interchangeable, and absent telemetry must remain not measured rather than a fabricated zero or healthy success rate.
canonical_prevention: Keep dashboard selector and missing-data contracts beside the dashboard tests, anchored to observed production label values and emitter ownership. Preserve denominator-backed zero fallbacks only for measured populations, and record per-panel verification against the production datasource separately from static checks.
